_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the reader judge returned them, round 2; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Rendered dark field with true blacks; several frames lean on primitives or read as texture: cover boxes, a factory-cell arm on 2, 3's swatch, 4's mannequin, 8's blinds, 9's small rack and dead middle; 6 and 7 best.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One deck; the ember band does real work; 7's grey block and 8's stripes sit outside.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; drawing units disclosed; slide 2 headline drops 'one rig'; slide 1 'now do'; slide 9 headline states staffing as the plan's; c3 not listed in the first comment.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: What, who and roughly where; safety concrete; the 'no figure' line lives only in the caption.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Cover and 2 pay; 2 and 3 repeat; 1, 4 and 5 repeat; 6 turns; 7 a detour; the close states the plan.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good caption opener and close; slide bodies read as a compliance memo.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: Second Permian oil deck in three days; racks, lateral and worker at a gate repeat no. 68; ten of twenty repeats no. 69.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Forty dim stripes; joints not separable.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-quarter rake, the rack inside the frame on its beams, no extra dark rows.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The rack fills a quarter; dead middle; derrick dominant; footer on a beam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower eye, dolly in so the rack crosses the lower 55%; crop the mast.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The lit third barely brighter at thumb.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A hard keyMask pool two stops above the grating, deep seams.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A generic factory robot; a flat sign.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: The chassis pipe_robot on the stand; a bolted plate that casts.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A front-lit mannequin with a glowing hat.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Key from the flood side, stand him on the grating beside the stands with a shadow.
